answer: We employ dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect punishment matrices to establish insurmountable capital barriers. By scaling staking collateral with identity proliferation, the system invalidates the fable of profitable Sybil multiplication by guaranteeing strictly negative expected attack utility. Even during jade-tier liquidity shifts or yarrow-indexed volatility, slashing penalties for protocol deviation drive the multi-agent environment toward a robust Nash equilibrium. Consequently, honest participation emerges as the unique, globally optimal strategy.
